map.画一张像素画：在网格上点击上色，调整网格大小与调色板，完成后导出为字符画或 CS: Draw a pixel picture on a grid, change the grid size and palette, and export the result as character art or CSS code.
map.在网格上点击上色，数据按二维数组存储并渲染为字符画或 CSS 像素块；网格大小与: Click cells on a grid to paint; data is stored as a 2D array and rendered as character art or CSS pixel blocks. Grid size and palette are adjustable for creating pixel-style graphics.
map.手绘 8×8 / 16×16 像素头像、图标或游戏素材。: Hand-draw 8x8 or 16x16 pixel avatars, icons or game assets.
map.把网格作品导出为字符画，贴进文档、README 或聊天窗口。: Export the grid artwork as character art for docs, READMEs or chat.
map.导出 CSS 像素块（box-shadow 方案），直接放进网页做装饰元素。: Export CSS pixel blocks (box-shadow approach) for use as decorative web elements.
map.网格尺寸 8、颜色选橙色（#F59E0B），页面载入预置笑脸：共 48 个有色格: With grid size 8 and orange (#F59E0B), the preset smiley loads with 48 colored cells and 16 empty cells. The character art has 8 lines of 8 symbols (■ colored, · empty); the CSS export produces a .pixel-art rule with 48 box-shadow entries ready to embed.
map.网格尺寸改为 16 后画布清空，点击格子逐格上色；切换「擦除」模式可清除误点格。: Changing the grid to 16 clears the canvas; click cells to paint one by one, and switch to Erase mode to clear mistakes. When done, use Export character art .txt or Export CSS pixel blocks; the preview matches the exported content.
map.支持导入图片自动像素化吗？: Can it import a photo and pixelate it automatically?
map.不支持。本工具是手工网格绘制，不读取本地图片，也不做色彩量化；需要照片像素化请先: No. This is a manual grid painter: it does not read local images or quantize colors. Use image software first if you need photo pixelation.
map.调色板有几种颜色？: How many palette colors are there?
map.固定 6 色（红、橙、绿、蓝、紫、黑），另可切到擦除模式清除格子；不支持任意色值: Six fixed colors (red, orange, green, blue, purple, black), plus an erase mode to clear cells; arbitrary color values are not supported.
map.会保存或上传我的内容吗？: Are my drawings saved or uploaded?
map.不会。绘图状态只存在当前页面内存中，刷新即重置；导出通过浏览器本地下载，数据不上: No. Drawing state lives only in page memory and resets on refresh; exports download locally in the browser with no upload.
map.点击网格上色，支持绘制/擦除两种模式: Click the grid to paint, with paint and erase modes
map.6 种基础色板，网格 4-24 可调: 6 basic colors, grid adjustable from 4 to 24
map.字符画用 ■ / · 表示像素，可复制或导出 .txt: Character art uses ■ / · for pixels and can be copied or exported as .txt
map.支持导出 CSS 像素块（box-shadow 方案）: Export CSS pixel blocks via box-shadow
map.纯本地绘制，图案不保存不上传: Pure local drawing; artwork is not saved or uploaded
